scope.summary: Implement StudioImportProfile + StudioExportRecipe for the CAD family: .dwg (row 21, I·X, CAD vector with drawing-scale support, transformed to Studio vector, non-vector CAD entities receipted) and .dxf (row 22, I·X, CAD interchange transformed with drawing scale, unsupported entities receipted). Five-artifact gate + fixtures + receipts + recovery.
acceptance_criteria: DWG/DXF I·X CAD vector + drawing scale + entity receipts; fixtures+recovery; manual entry
proof_targets: DWG/DXF fixtures + scale-transform + entity receipt + recovery test
expected_tests: round-trip: CAD vector + drawing scale transformed, bounded envelope
receipt: non-vector/unsupported-entity receipt; recovery: malformed DWG/DXF fails closed

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: No CAD interop; technical-drawing exchange gap.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
